import re
from datetime import datetime
from collections import defaultdict

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Assuming each bill file contains a line like "Total Amount => $..."; will verify by extracting from all 2023 electricity bill files, preferring .txt when both .pdf and .txt exist for the same month.</uncertainty>')

year = datetime.now().year

# Use existing fs_token from previous cells

items_elec = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')
year_prefix = f'{year}-'
year_files = [p for p in items_elec if year_prefix in p and not p.endswith('/')]

# Map month->file (prefer txt)
month_to_txt = {}
month_to_pdf = {}
for p in year_files:
    m = re.search(r'/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$', p)
    if not m:
        continue
    yy, mm, ext = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
    month_key = f'{yy}-{mm}'
    if ext == 'txt':
        month_to_txt[month_key] = p
    elif ext == 'pdf':
        month_to_pdf[month_key] = p

months = sorted(set(month_to_txt.keys()) | set(month_to_pdf.keys()))
print('year', year)
print('months_found', months)

selected = []
for mk in months:
    if mk in month_to_txt:
        selected.append(month_to_txt[mk])
    else:
        selected.append(month_to_pdf[mk])

print('selected_files_count', len(selected))
print('selected_files', selected)

# extract totals
amounts = {}
pattern = re.compile(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9][0-9,]*\.?[0-9]*)', re.IGNORECASE)

for p in selected:
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=p).get('content','')
    mm = re.search(r'(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$', p)
    month_key = f"{mm.group(1)}-{mm.group(2)}" if mm else p
    m = pattern.search(content)
    print('file', p, 'matched', bool(m))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError(f'Could not find Total Amount in {p}')
    amt_str = m.group(1)
    amt_val = float(amt_str.replace(',',''))
    amounts[month_key] = amt_val

print('amounts_by_month', amounts)
print('sum', sum(amounts.values()))

from datetime import datetime
import re

# total already computed from electricity 2023 .txt files
# Recompute once quickly for verification
year = datetime.now().year
items_elec = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')

pattern = re.compile(r'/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.txt$')
amount_re = re.compile(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9][0-9,]*\.?[0-9]*)', re.IGNORECASE)

total = 0.0
found = []
for p in items_elec:
    m = pattern.search(p)
    if not m:
        continue
    yy = int(m.group(1)); mm = m.group(2)
    if yy != year:
        continue
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=p).get('content','')
    am = amount_re.search(content)
    if not am:
        raise RuntimeError('missing total in '+p)
    amt = float(am.group(1).replace(',',''))
    total += amt
    found.append((mm, p, amt))

found_sorted = sorted(found, key=lambda x: int(x[0]))
print('year', year)
print('found_months', [(mm, amt) for mm,_,amt in found_sorted])
print('computed_total', total)

# complete task with integer if whole number
answer = int(total) if abs(total - round(total)) < 1e-9 else total
resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=answer)
print('complete_task_response', resp)
